_meta.description: Translator-context sidecar for auth.forgot-password. Initiate-password-reset surface.
_meta.audience: Users who have forgotten their password.
_meta.tone: Reassuring; do not confirm or deny that an account exists for the submitted email.
_meta.security: successMessage MUST be account-enumeration safe — never differentiate between 'account exists' and 'account does not exist' in any locale.

successMessage._use: Account-enumeration-safe success copy. Translation MUST stay neutral about whether the email is a real account.
